title: What If Dark Matter Is Just Black Holes?
summary: PBS Space Time asks whether dark matter could be made of primordial black holes. It walks through the observational constraints that limit this idea.
why: HN people link it in dark matter and black hole threads as a clear summary of why black holes alone are unlikely to explain dark matter.
topic: dark matter and primordial black holes

quote.text: Matt demonstrates point by point that there aren't enough black holes to be dark matter for several reasons/types
